ID.Local: Tipo de documento de identificación del trabajador
ID.Format: N(2) DIAN numeric catalogue; emitted as A(2) alpha on PILA and cesantías
ID.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.Document_Type - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE044, table 5.2.1), CO-PILA-003 (T2R2-003), CO-DIAN-004 (casilla 24), CO-CESANTIAS-006 (T03); Mandatory=Y on all four. Scope option_mapper_scope.personal_id_type. Validates the length of the document NUMBER - a PEP must be exactly 15 digits (SOI hard rule). CO-GAP-06: no code exists for the PPT (Permiso por Protección Temporal, Decreto 216 de 2021); code 47 (PEP) is the only available proxy.

ID.Format: Numeric, no separators (cédula 8-10 digits; PEP exactly 15). Alphanumeric only for passport (41), foreign identity document (42) and foreign tax number (50)
ID.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.Document_Number - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE045), CO-PILA-003 (T2R2-004, A(16) space-filled), CO-DIAN-004 (casilla 25), CO-CESANTIAS-006 (T04, N(16) zero-filled); Mandatory=Y on all four. CO-GAP-07 (SCHEMA TRAP): NIE045 is typed xsd:integer in the nómina electrónica XSD, so an alphanumeric passport number cannot be schema-valid. No official workaround published - carry as an open item.

ID.PreCond: Mandatory where Payment Method is a bank-mediated medium (42, 45, 47, 48, 49). Must be absent or empty where Payment Method = 10 (efectivo).
ID.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.Bank_Name (CO-DIAN-001 NIE066, Mandatory=C). Bidirectional set with Payment Method, Bank Account Type and Bank Account Number.

ID.PreCond: Mandatory together with Employee Bank Name and Employee Bank Account Number where Payment Method is a bank-mediated medium.
Mandatory together with Employee Bank Name and Employee Bank Account Type where Payment Method is a bank-mediated medium.
ID.Format: Numeric, bank-specific length (commonly 10-17 digits). NOT an IBAN.
ID.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.Bank_Account_Number (CO-DIAN-001 NIE068, Mandatory=C). CCG Module 2.2 confirms no IBAN and no national check digit - do not apply an IBAN validator.
Spec ref: Employee.Internal_Code (CO-DIAN-001 NIE047, Mandatory=N). Not the document number and not a substitute for it.

ID.Local: Número de cuenta del fondo de cesantías
ID.PreCond: Mandatory where the fund requires an account number on the deposit file; otherwise the employee is identified by document type plus document number validated against the Asofondos affiliate base.
ID.Notes: Declared in build_co_specs._DD_MASTER_MAPPINGS as Employee.Cesantias_Fund_Account but not carried as a positional field in the published Simple S.A. / SOI layout, which keys the record on document type + number. DERIVED - confirm per-fund requirement with RA.

ID.FieldType: Field Type (Text, Number, Date, Integer, Decimal, Counter)

ID.Format: N(9) to N(10) - no dots, no hyphens, no verification digit
ID.Notes: Spec ref: Company.NIT - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE038), CO-DIAN-002 (casilla 5), CO-DIAN-004, CO-DIAN-005; Mandatory=Y on all four. Validation rules NIE038 and NIE041 require the number 'sin guiones ni DV' in one attribute and the verification digit in another - an engine that concatenates them FAILS schema validation. The last digit(s) of the NIT also fix the filing deadline for Formulario 350, PILA and the información exógena.

ID.PreCond: On the contribution return the value is mandatory where Employer Person Type = J (jurídica); for every other case the field must be ZERO.
ID.Notes: Spec ref: Company.NIT_DV - all four DIAN artefacts plus CO-PILA-003 (A1-004). Verified algorithm (CCG Module 2.1): weights [3,7,13,17,19,23,29,37,41,43,47,53,59,67,71] applied right to left, S = sum(digit_i x W_i), R = S mod 11, DV = R if R < 2 else 11 - R. Verified against NIT 902025831 -> DV 4 and NIT 800197268 -> DV 4. Stored, not recomputed at runtime, but validated on entry.

Spec ref: Company.Document_Type (CO-PILA-003 A1-001, Mandatory=Y) and the composite Company.Document_Type + Company.Document_Number ('Tipo y número de documento del aportante') on CO-CESANTIAS-006. Where Employer Person Type = N (natural) the type NI is NOT available. Company.Document_Number (CO-PILA-003 A1-002, A(16)) is NOT a separate master-data field: for a legal person it is the Employer NIT and for a natural person it is the personal document number - hold the value once and emit it into whichever field the artefact requires.

ID.PreCond: Mandatory for commercial entities and for any employer claiming the Ley 1429 de 2010 formalisation benefits or the Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 34 part-time contribution regime.
ID.Format: Alphanumeric - format set by each Chamber of Commerce
ID.Notes: CCG Module 2.1. One of only three sub-national registration elements in Colombian payroll (the others being the family compensation fund and the work-centre risk class). DERIVED format - the Chambers do not publish a common mask; confirm with RA.

ID.Format: String assigned by DIAN at software activation
ID.Notes: CCG Module 2.1; Res. DIAN 000013 de 2021 arts. 1, 5, 22. THE PAIRED PIN IS A CREDENTIAL: it never appears in the XML and is held in the integration credential store described in CO-SIR-001, NOT in this Data Dictionary. The security code itself (SHA-384 of SoftwareID + PIN + document number) is a COMPUTED value (SYS), not master data.

ID.Local: Prefijo de numeración de la nómina electrónica
ID.Notes: CCG Module 2.1. The CONSECUTIVE NUMBER is generated by the engine (SYS), not master data. DIAN global validation rule 90 rejects a repeated document number for the same employee; a rejected document must be re-transmitted with a NEW consecutive number.

ID.Format: N(2) - assigned by the operador's own system
ID.Notes: Spec ref: CO-PILA-003 Field Options ('Código del operador de información', 2 digits). CCG Module 2.1 item 9 - an employer-level election stored once and inherited by every employee. Operadores are private entities licensed by the Ministerio de Salud y Protección Social.

ID.Local: Tipo de identificación del representante legal
ID.PreCond: Mandatory where Employer Person Type = J (jurídica); optional where Employer Person Type = N (natural). Bidirectional pair with Employer Person Type.
ID.Format: A(2) - narrower catalogue than the contributor list
ID.Notes: Spec ref: Company.Legal_Rep_ID_Type (CO-PILA-003 A1-017, Mandatory=C). NI, TI, SC, PE and RC are NOT available for a legal representative even though several of them are available for a contributor.

ID.Local: Número de identificación del representante legal / signatario
ID.PreCond: Mandatory where Employer Person Type = J (jurídica); optional where Employer Person Type = N. Bidirectional pair with Employer Person Type and with the legal-representative name block.
ID.Format: A(16) on PILA, left-justified and space-filled; numeric on Formulario 350
ID.Notes: Spec ref: Company.Legal_Rep_ID (CO-DIAN-002 casilla 981 signatario, CO-PILA-003 A1-018; Mandatory=Y/C).

ID.PreCond: Populated wherever the signatory identification number is populated.
ID.Notes: Spec ref: Company.Legal_Rep_ID_DV (CO-DIAN-002, CO-PILA-003; Mandatory=Y). Same weighted modulus-11 algorithm as the employer NIT DV.

CF.Format: A(20) on PILA and cesantías; variable length on the DIAN artefacts
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.First_Surname - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE048), CO-PILA-003 (T2R2-011), CO-DIAN-004 (casillas 26-29), CO-CESANTIAS-006 (T05); Mandatory=Y on all four. Validated as a SET with the other three name parts against the Asofondos affiliate base on the cesantías deposit.

CF.PreCond: The nómina electrónica schema declares this a REQUIRED attribute even though many Colombians and virtually all foreign nationals have only one surname. Where the person has no second surname a placeholder must be emitted or schema validation fails. Space-filled on the PILA and cesantías fixed-width layouts.
CF.Format: A(20) on PILA and cesantías; variable length on the DIAN artefacts
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.Second_Surname - all four per-employee artefacts. SCHEMA TRAP recorded in CCG Module 2.2: no official guidance exists on the placeholder value. Carry as an open item and agree the placeholder with RA before go-live.

CF.Format: A(20) on PILA and cesantías; variable length on the DIAN artefacts
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.First_Name - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE050), CO-PILA-003 (T2R2-013), CO-DIAN-004, CO-CESANTIAS-006 (T07); Mandatory=Y on all four.

CF.PreCond: Conditional on the person having a second or further given name; space-filled on the fixed-width layouts when absent.
CF.Format: A(20) on PILA and cesantías; A(30) on the PILA employer block; variable on DIAN
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.Other_Names - all four per-employee artefacts (Mandatory=C/N). PILA calls the field 'Segundo nombre'; the nómina electrónica calls it 'OtrosNombres' and accepts more than one given name in the single attribute.

Not filing-mandated on the in-scope returns. CCG Module 2.2 records the minor-to-adult document-type change. Retirement age (57 women / 62 men, public defined-benefit regime) affects entitlement, not the payroll rate - see CCG Module 5.
Not reported on any of the six in-scope statutory filings and not a calculation driver. Held for HR master data and affiliation paperwork only.

Calculation-driving classifier. NOT the same question as Tax Residence Status: a Colombian national can be a non-resident and a foreign national can be a resident. Keep the two fields independent - see CCG Module 2.2 and the resident/non-resident matrix at Module 6.2.

CF.PreCond: Mandatory on the annual severance-savings deposit record. Must be consistent with the residence department and municipality codes, which are the DANE halves of the same address.
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.Address (CO-CESANTIAS-006 T15, Mandatory=C). DISTINCT from Place of Work Address - the nómina electrónica reports where the employee WORKS, this reports where the employee LIVES. Do not map one to the other.

CF.PreCond: Mandatory wherever the residential address is reported. Must be the department half of the same five-digit DIVIPOLA code whose municipality half is the residence municipality code.
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.Department_Code (CO-CESANTIAS-006 T16, Mandatory=C). Use the DANE DIVIPOLA catalogue, NOT the ISO 3166-2:CO list on the reference sheets.

CF.PreCond: Mandatory wherever the residential address is reported. Must be the municipality half of the same five-digit DIVIPOLA code whose department half is the residence department code.
CF.Format: N(3) DANE DIVIPOLA suffix (e.g. 001 for Bogotá D.C. within department 11)
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.Municipality_Code (CO-CESANTIAS-006 T17, Mandatory=C). SPLIT-CODE TRAP: PILA, Formulario 220 and the cesantías file carry the department and municipality in SEPARATE 2 + 3 fields, whereas the nómina electrónica carries ONE five-digit code (11001). Store the five digits once and split on output.

CF.PreCond: Conditional on an e-mail address being held for the employee.
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.Email (CO-CESANTIAS-006 T18, Mandatory=C).

CF.PreCond: Conditional on a 7-digit landline being held; the layout is filled with spaces or zeros where only a mobile number exists.
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.Phone (CO-CESANTIAS-006 T19, Mandatory=C). The layout has no mobile-number field - a mobile number cannot be substituted.

CF.PreCond: Usable ONLY where Employee Document Type is cédula de ciudadanía (13 / CC) or tarjeta de identidad (12 / TI). Where set, Place of Work Department Code and Place of Work Municipality Code must be blank.
CF.Format: S / N (emitted as blank or X on the PILA fixed-width file)
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.Colombian_Abroad_Flag (CO-PILA-003 T2R2-008, Mandatory=C). Bidirectional set with Employee Document Type and the two work-location codes.

Spec ref: Employee.Work_Country_Code (CO-DIAN-001 NIE051, Mandatory=Y). For a transnational teleworker a Colombian contract remains governed by Colombian law and the ARL must guarantee cover in the country of performance - Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 54, CCG Module 11.

CF.PreCond: Mandatory on the nómina electrónica. Left BLANK on the contribution return where the Colombian Abroad Flag is set, and where Worker Type = 40 (beneficiario UPC adicional).
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.Work_Department_Code (CO-DIAN-001 NIE052 Mandatory=Y; CO-PILA-003 T2R2-009 Mandatory=C). Bidirectional set with the Colombian Abroad Flag and Worker Type.

CF.PreCond: Mandatory on the nómina electrónica. Left BLANK on the contribution return in the same two cases as the work-location department code - Colombian Abroad Flag set, or Worker Type = 40.
CF.Format: N(5) full DIVIPOLA on the nómina electrónica (11001); N(3) municipality suffix on PILA
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.Work_Municipality_Code (CO-DIAN-001 NIE053; CO-PILA-003 T2R2-010). SPLIT-CODE TRAP - see Residence Municipality Code. Store five digits once and split on output.
Spec ref: Employee.Work_Address (CO-DIAN-001 NIE054, Mandatory=Y). DISTINCT from the employee's residential address.

CF.PreCond: Mandatory where the employer operates more than one work centre, and mandatory where the VCT change-of-work-centre event is reported for the period.
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.Work_Centre_Code (CO-PILA-003 T2R2-091, Mandatory=C). Bidirectional set with the VCT novedad and with the work centre's Occupational Risk Class. Legal basis: Decreto 1072 de 2015 art. 2.2.4.2.5.6 - a company with a corporate office and a plant legitimately carries two different risk classes. The RATE itself is a parameter (WTC), not DD.

Spec ref: Contract.Start_Date - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE057, Mandatory=Y), CO-PILA-003 (T2R2-080, mandatory where the ING novedad is marked), CO-CESANTIAS-006 (T09, Mandatory=Y). Seniority driver for the severance-savings liquidation, the indemnity tier and work-clothing eligibility. Colombia has NO cumulative-withholding carry-over between employers and no P45 equivalent - a new employer starts the withholding calculation fresh (CCG Module 2.2).

CF.PreCond: Mandatory upon a leaver event: populated on the nómina electrónica only for the month in which the relationship ends, and mandatory on the contribution return where the RET (retiro) novedad is marked.
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Contract.End_Date - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE058, Mandatory=C), CO-PILA-003 (T2R2-081, Mandatory=C). Bidirectional pair with the RET novedad. Must fall inside or before the settlement window of the document.

Spec ref: Contract.Type_Code (CO-DIAN-001 NIE059, Mandatory=Y). Scope option_mapper_scope.contract_type. Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 21 recast the apprenticeship as a special fixed-term LABOUR contract, regulated by Decreto 0223 of 5 March 2026 - it is now a contract type, not a training arrangement.

CF.Local: Tipo de trabajador / tipo de cotizante
CF.Format: N(2) zero-filled - e.g. 01 (Anexo Técnico table 5.5.3 / PILA tipo cotizante)
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.Worker_Type_Code (CO-DIAN-001 NIE055, CO-PILA-003 T2R2-005; Mandatory=Y on both). MAPPING TRAP: the nómina electrónica table 5.5.3 carries only SIXTEEN values while the PILA tipo cotizante list carries far more - copying a PILA code straight into the XML is a documented failure. Public-sector codes 18, 30, 47 and 58, domestic service 02, community mothers 04, associated-work cooperative members 31 and every independent-worker code are OUT OF SCOPE - see the mapper Notes.

CF.Local: Subtipo de trabajador / subtipo de cotizante
CF.Format: N(2) zero-filled - 00 where no sub-type applies
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.Worker_SubType_Code (CO-DIAN-001 NIE056, CO-PILA-003 T2R2-006; Mandatory=Y on both). HARD RULE: where the sub-type is 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, 09 or 12 the PILA pension-contribution rate field MUST be 0. This field carries the 'active pensioner' attribute - do NOT create a separate active-pensioner flag. MAPPING TRAP: the nómina electrónica table 5.5.4 carries only 00 and 01; PILA carries more.

Spec ref: Contract.Pay_Frequency_Code (CO-DIAN-001 NIE060, Mandatory=Y). CRITICAL CONFIGURATION POINT: whatever the frequency, the electronic payroll support document is ONE MONTHLY document per employee - Res. DIAN 000013 de 2021 art. 3, 'con independencia de que el obligado realice pagos en periodos diferentes o inferiores'. A semi-monthly payroll does NOT produce two filings a month.
Spec ref: Contract.Payment_Form_Code (CO-DIAN-001 NIE064, Mandatory=Y). Distinct from Payment Method - 'forma' is cash-vs-credit settlement, 'método' is the medium.

Spec ref: Contract.Payment_Method_Code (CO-DIAN-001 NIE065, Mandatory=Y). Bidirectional set with the three bank fields: where the value is 10 (efectivo) the bank attributes must be ABSENT; where it is a bank-mediated medium they are all required.

CF.Format: Hours per week, up to 2 decimals (e.g. 42.00)
CF.Notes: CCG Module 2.2 working-time group. Calculation-driving: the ordinary hourly rate, and therefore every overtime and night-surcharge value, is derived from it. NOT on any in-scope statutory filing - held as a calculation input. The 42-hour step is a PARAMETER (WTC); this field is the employee's contracted value.
CCG Module 2.2 working-time group. Together with the obligatory rest day it determines which days attract the Sunday / public-holiday surcharge. Not on any in-scope statutory filing.
CCG Module 2.2. Calculation-driving: the Sunday / public-holiday surcharge attaches to the designated rest day, not automatically to the calendar Sunday. Default value: Domingo.

CF.Local: Jornada por turnos sucesivos de 36 horas
CF.Notes: CCG Module 2.2 working-time group. Calculation-driving where set. Not on any in-scope statutory filing.

CF.PreCond: Mandatory where the employee is a teleworker under Ley 1221 de 2008 as amended by Ley 2466 de 2025 arts. 52-54; defaults to on-site otherwise.
CF.Notes: CCG Module 4 (connectivity allowance, Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 53) and Module 2.2. Calculation-driving: selects connectivity allowance vs transport allowance. The nómina electrónica carries a dedicated Teletrabajo devengado element (NIE158); the ALLOWANCE AMOUNT is a parameter/wage type (WTC), not DD.

CF.Format: Boolean true/false on the nómina electrónica XML; S / N (blank or X) on PILA
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.Integral_Salary_Flag (CO-DIAN-001 NIE062 Mandatory=Y; CO-PILA-003 T2R2-072 Mandatory=C). HARD RULE: where set, the four PILA contribution-base fields must be 70% of the integral salary. An all-inclusive-salary employee accrues NO separate severance savings, service bonus or severance interest - see the Severance-Savings Regime field.

CF.PreCond: Mandatory where any wage type paid to the employee is treated as non-salary by written pact. The pact must be (a) express, (b) written and (c) attached to identified payments.
CF.Notes: CCG Module 4 (Labour Code art. 128; Ley 1393 de 2010 art. 30). Calculation-driving: a valid pact removes the payment from the labour-law salary base permanently, but excludes it from the CONTRIBUTION base only up to 40% of total remuneration - everything above that line is added back. The 40% clamp itself is a parameter and the add-back is a calculated amount (WTC); this flag is the master-data switch that turns the clamp on.

CF.Local: Actividad de alto riesgo para pensión
CF.Format: Boolean true/false on the nómina electrónica XML; S / N (blank or X) on PILA
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.High_Risk_Pension_Flag (CO-DIAN-001 NIE061 Mandatory=Y; CO-PILA-003 T2R2-071 Mandatory=C). Bidirectional pair with the PILA pension-contribution-rate field. The RATE is a parameter (WTC), not DD.

CF.Local: Situación de discapacidad / estabilidad laboral reforzada
CF.Notes: CCG Modules 2.1 and 9. NOT a contribution or withholding driver in Colombia - Colombia has no disability-percentage tax relief on the payroll side. Held as a compliance-path selector.

Calculation-driving. Resident: the progressive art. 383 table (0/19/28/33/35/37/39%) on the art. 388 depurated base, by Procedure 1 or 2. Non-resident: a FLAT 20% under art. 408 on the GROSS payment, with no depuration, no 25% exempt income, no art. 387 deductions and no tax-free band (DIAN Concepto 011108 of 29 June 2026, upholding Concepto 1789 int. 14595 of 2025). THE SWITCH IS PROSPECTIVE, NEVER RETROACTIVE. INTERNAL CONFLICT TO ESCALATE: CCG Module 2.2 states a non-resident employee is withheld on the same art. 383 table, which contradicts the Module 6.2 matrix and the scope_manifest; Module 6.2 is the authoritative text and is the basis of this field.

CF.Local: Procedimiento de retención en la fuente
CF.Notes: Calculation-driving. CCG Module 6.2: the procedure is elected by the EMPLOYER, per employee, and once elected Procedure 2 binds for the whole six-month semester. The FIXED PERCENTAGE produced by the June/December recalculation is a CALCULATED value (CALC/WTC), not master data. Not available at all for a non-resident, who is withheld at the flat art. 408 rate.

CF.Local: Tarifa de retención solicitada por el trabajador
CF.Notes: CCG Module 6.2. This is a USER-INPUT rate, not a statutory parameter: the statutory tables and thresholds remain in the WTC / parameter set. Requires a written employee request on file.

CF.PreCond: Mandatory on every Formulario 350 annex row, i.e. wherever a payment is made to a non-resident. Not applicable to a resident employee.
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.Treaty_Country_Code (CO-DIAN-002 casilla 141, Mandatory=C). SIN CONVENIO -> concepto 5 (prestación de servicios y compensación por servicios personales), rate 20% under ET art. 408. CON CONVENIO -> concepto 24 (rentas de trabajo), rate taken from the applicable treaty and possibly lower or nil.

CF.PreCond: Mandatory on every Formulario 350 annex row. Where Treaty Status = CON CONVENIO the country must be one with a treaty in force with Colombia.
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.Treaty_Country_Code (CO-DIAN-002, Mandatory=C). Treaties in force include ES, CL, CH, CA, MX, KR, PT, IN, CZ, GB, FR, IT and JP; Bolivia, Ecuador and Peru are covered by Andean Community Decision 578 rather than a bilateral treaty. The TREATY RATE is a parameter (WTC), not DD - confirm the current list with RA each year.

CF.PreCond: Mandatory where the employee is not obliged to file an income-tax return and asks that Formulario 220 serve as the substitute. Section 2 of Formulario 220 is completed from the employee's declaration, not from payroll data.
CF.Notes: Spec ref: CO-DIAN-004 Formulario 220 section 2 (ET arts. 378-380). The MONETARY conditions (4,500 UVT gross assets; 1,400 UVT gross income, consumption and deposits) are parameters (WTC); this field records only that the declaration was obtained. Evidence must be retained.

CF.PreCond: Mandatory where the employee claims the dependants deduction; enter 0 if none. Each dependant must also be identified individually - a count alone is not sufficient for the annual information return.
CF.Notes: Calculation-driving family attribute. CCG Module 2.2 and Module 6/7. The DEDUCTION AMOUNTS and caps (10% of gross employment income capped at 32 UVT per month; the additional 72 UVT per dependant per year under art. 336 num. 3, up to four dependants) are parameters and calculated amounts (WTC), NOT DD. Not available to a non-resident.

CF.Local: Tipo de documento del dependiente económico
CF.PreCond: Mandatory where the employee claimed the art. 387 par. 2 dependants deduction during the period. Populated as a bidirectional set with the dependant's document number, name and relationship - all four together or none.
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.Dependant_Document_Type (CO-DIAN-004 casilla 79; CO-DIAN-005 Formato 2276, Mandatory=C). The information return requires the dependant's DOCUMENT, not merely a count - a missing document rejects the return. The Form 220 list is NARROWER than the nómina electrónica list.

CF.Local: Número de documento del dependiente económico
CF.PreCond: Mandatory together with the dependant's document type, name and relationship wherever the dependants deduction is claimed.
CF.Format: Numeric / alphanumeric per the dependant's document type
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.Dependant_Document_Number (CO-DIAN-004 casilla 80; CO-DIAN-005 Formato 2276, Mandatory=C).

CF.Local: Apellidos y nombres del dependiente económico
CF.PreCond: Mandatory together with the dependant's document type, document number and relationship.
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.Dependant_Name (CO-DIAN-004 casilla 81, Mandatory=C).

CF.PreCond: Mandatory together with the dependant's document type, document number and name. The qualifying evidence (education enrolment, medical certification of dependency, absence of income) must be retained.
CF.Format: Coded value; emitted as free text on Formulario 220 casilla 82
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.Dependant_Relationship (CO-DIAN-004 casilla 82, Mandatory=C). Calculation-driving: the five limbs of ET art. 387 par. 2 are exhaustive; a person outside them is not a dependant however genuine the support.

CF.Local: Código de la EPS o EOC del afiliado
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.EPS_Code (CO-PILA-003 T2R2-033, Mandatory=Y). Codes come from the operador's administradoras catalogue, which is an EXTERNAL reference table maintained by the Ministerio de Salud - not enumerated here. CCG Module 2.2: a wrong institution code produces rejected or misdirected contributions.

CF.Local: Código de la EPS o EOC a la cual se traslada el afiliado
CF.PreCond: Mandatory where the TAE (traslado a otra EPS) novedad is reported for the period; blank otherwise. Bidirectional pair with the TAE change event.
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.EPS_Transfer_Code (CO-PILA-003 T2R2-034, Mandatory=C). Scope option_mapper_scope.benefit_type (TDE / TAE).

CF.Local: Código de la administradora de fondos de pensiones del afiliado
CF.PreCond: Mandatory in general. Blank is permitted ONLY where the Worker Type or Worker Sub-Type is one that is not obliged to contribute to the general pension system - notably Worker Sub-Type 01, an employed old-age pensioner in active service.
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.AFP_Code (CO-PILA-003 T2R2-031, Mandatory=C). Bidirectional set with Worker Type and Worker Sub-Type.

CF.Local: Código de la administradora de pensiones a la cual se traslada el afiliado
CF.PreCond: Mandatory where the TAP (traslado a otra administradora de pensiones) novedad is reported for the period; blank otherwise. Bidirectional pair with the TAP change event.
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.AFP_Transfer_Code (CO-PILA-003 T2R2-032, Mandatory=C). Scope option_mapper_scope.benefit_type (TDP / TAP).

CCG Module 5. Employee election that survives a change of employer and must be declared by a new joiner. Determines which administrator catalogue the AFP code is drawn from and which voluntary-contribution route (art. 55 RAIS voluntary contributions vs additional RPM contributions) is available. The CONTRIBUTION RATES are identical across the two regimes and are parameters (WTC).

CF.Local: Código de la caja de compensación familiar
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.CCF_Code (CO-PILA-003 T2R2-035, Mandatory=Y). EMPLOYER election (CCG Module 2.1), inherited by the employee, unlike the EPS and AFP which the employee chooses. The 4% levy is NEVER exonerated under ET art. 114-1.

CF.Local: Código de la administradora de riesgos laborales del afiliado
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.ARL_Code (CO-PILA-003 T2R2-077, Mandatory=Y). EMPLOYER election, inherited by the employee. Normally equal to the employer ARL code; held per employee because the contribution-return layout carries both.

CF.Local: Código del fondo de cesantías del afiliado
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.Cesantias_Fund_Code (CO-CESANTIAS-006 T02, Mandatory=Y). IGNORED where the employer files a single-fund planilla, in which case the planilla-level fund overwrites this value for every record - see the employer field 'Single-Fund Planilla Severance Fund Code'. Any value outside the registered list is REJECTED.

Calculation-driving, and a documented reporting trap. Formulario 220 reports the pre-1991 regime at casilla 48 and the amount deposited to the fund at casilla 49, while Formato 2276 reports them in the OPPOSITE order at numerals N19 (fund) and N20 (traditional). MAP BY MEANING, NEVER BY POSITION - see CO-DIAN-004 and CO-DIAN-005 Field Options.

CF.PreCond: Mandatory for every employee under the Ley 50 de 1990 regime. Where the value is MENSUAL a written agreement must be on file, and the monthly-advance fields of the deposit file are produced; where it is ANUAL only the ordinary annual detail record is produced.
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Contract.Cesantias_Regime (CO-CESANTIAS-006 MA01 'Acuerdo escrito para la consignación mensual anticipada', Mandatory=C) - the spec models the monthly-advance gate as a Y/N flag; this DD models the full four-way arrangement and MENSUAL is the value that maps to Y. LATE DEPOSIT COSTS ONE DAY'S SALARY PER DAY OF DELAY, PER EMPLOYEE, UNCAPPED (Ley 50 de 1990 art. 99 num. 3).

CF.FieldName: Foreign National Not Liable to Pension Flag
CF.Local: Extranjero no obligado a cotizar a pensiones
CF.PreCond: Where set, the ONLY valid values of Employee Document Type are cédula de extranjería (CE), pasaporte (PA), carné diplomático (CD), salvoconducto (SC) and permiso especial de permanencia (PE). Bidirectional pair with Employee Document Type.
CF.Format: S / N (emitted as blank or X on the PILA fixed-width file)
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.Foreign_Not_Pension_Liable_Flag (CO-PILA-003 T2R2-007, Mandatory=C). Calculation-driving: suppresses the pension contribution only. Health, occupational risk and the payroll levies continue to apply. Requires documentary proof on file.

CF.Local: Cotizante con más de un empleador
CF.PreCond: Mandatory where the new joiner declares another concurrent employer. The other employer's contribution base must also be captured to apportion the shared ceiling.
CF.Notes: CCG Module 2.2 new-joiner declarations; Ley 100 de 1993 art. 18 par. 1 as substituted by Ley 797 de 2003 art. 5. Calculation-driving switch. The other employer's BASE is a monetary input to the calculation and sits in the WTC / payroll-input set, not in this master-data field. Mis-configuration produces over- or under-contribution against the shared ceiling and is a standing UGPP audit exposure.

CF.Local: Tipo de documento del cotizante principal
CF.PreCond: Populated ONLY for a dependent-beneficiary record - typically Worker Type 40, beneficiario UPC adicional. Bidirectional pair with the principal contributor's document number and with Worker Type.
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.Main_Contributor_Doc_Type (CO-PILA-003 T2R2-074, Mandatory=C). Uses the PILA two-letter catalogue, not the DIAN numeric one.

CF.Local: Número de identificación del cotizante principal
CF.PreCond: Populated ONLY for a dependent-beneficiary record. Bidirectional pair with the principal contributor's document type.
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Employee.Main_Contributor_Doc_Number (CO-PILA-003 T2R2-075, Mandatory=C).

CF.PreCond: Pre-Condition for Conditional Mandatory
CF.FieldType: Field Type (Text, Number, Date, Integer, Decimal, Counter)
CF.Notes: Additional Notes

CF.PreCond: Populated where the employer is a LEGAL person or a sociedad de hecho. MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE with the four employer natural-person name fields: a natural-person employer must NOT populate this field.
CF.Format: A(200) on PILA; variable length on the DIAN artefacts
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Company.Legal_Name - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE032), CO-DIAN-002 (casilla 11), CO-DIAN-004, CO-PILA-003 (A1-011); Mandatory=Y/C. Bidirectional exclusivity with the natural-person name block, enforced by the instructivo of every artefact.

CF.PreCond: Populated ONLY where the employer is a natural person. Mutually exclusive with Employer Corporate Name.
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Company.First_Surname (CO-DIAN-001 NIE210, CO-DIAN-002 casilla 7, CO-DIAN-004; Mandatory=C).

CF.PreCond: Populated ONLY where the employer is a natural person. Mutually exclusive with Employer Corporate Name.
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Company.Second_Surname (CO-DIAN-001 NIE211, CO-DIAN-002 casilla 8, CO-DIAN-004; Mandatory=C).

CF.PreCond: Populated ONLY where the employer is a natural person. Mutually exclusive with Employer Corporate Name.
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Company.First_Name (CO-DIAN-001 NIE212, CO-DIAN-002 casilla 9, CO-DIAN-004; Mandatory=C).

CF.PreCond: Populated ONLY where the employer is a natural person. Mutually exclusive with Employer Corporate Name.
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Company.Other_Names (CO-DIAN-001 NIE213, CO-DIAN-002 casilla 10, CO-DIAN-004; Mandatory=C).

Spec ref: Company.Person_Type (CO-PILA-003 A1-009, Mandatory=Y). Where J: the NIT verification digit and the whole legal-representative block become mandatory. Where N: the valid employer document types narrow to CC, CE, TI, PA, CD, PE and SC - NI is not available - and the verification digit must be ZERO.

Spec ref: Company.Legal_Nature (CO-PILA-003 A1-008, Mandatory=Y). PRIVATE-SECTOR FILTER: the Mercans platform serves private employers, so only value 2 (Privada) is in scope. Public (1), mixed-capital (3), multilateral organisations (4) and foreign public-law entities not subject to Colombian law (5) are excluded - see the mapper Notes.

Spec ref: Company.Aportante_Class (CO-PILA-003 A1-007, Mandatory=Y). The headcount is counted across all branches and dependencies, NOT per branch. Class D (Ley 1429 de 2010 beneficiary) makes the commercial-registry date and the registered-seat department code mandatory.

Spec ref: Company.Aportante_Type (CO-PILA-003 A1-032, Mandatory=Y). PRIVATE-SECTOR FILTER: only value 1 (Empleador) is in scope. Independents (2), public entities and universities (3), guilds and religious congregations (4), associated-work cooperatives (5), diplomatic missions (6) and the remaining special payers (7-12) are excluded - see the mapper Notes.
Spec ref: Company.Presentation_Form (CO-PILA-003 A1-010, Mandatory=Y). Bidirectional pair with the branch code and branch name: where U, both MUST BE BLANK; where S, both become required.

CF.Local: Modalidad de la planilla (electrónica o asistida)
CF.Notes: Spec ref: CO-PILA-003 Field Options. Employer-level election gated by headcount under Decreto 780 de 2016 art. 3.2.3.9 as substituted by Decreto 1990 de 2016 - the headcount is aggregated across all branches under the same legal person. The THRESHOLD is a parameter (WTC); the elected modality is master data.

Scope option_mapper_scope.correction_codes. The DEFAULT is master data; the value actually used in a given run may be overridden by the event (A for omitted hires, N for corrections, M for arrears, J for a court-ordered settlement, X for a liquidated company) and that override is TRANSACTIONAL, not master data. Planilla types S, I, Y, T, F, H, K, U and O are out of scope - see the mapper Notes.

Spec ref: CO-DIAN-005 (Res. DIAN 000227 de 2025 par. 4). Where the value is 1 the trust and contract-participant numerals (N35, N36) 'no se deben diligenciar'. Values 2-8 attach to trust, mandate, consortium, hydrocarbons, joint-venture, participation-account and public-cooperation structures and are out of scope for ordinary employer payroll.

CF.Format: A(40) on PILA; variable length on the nómina electrónica
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Company.Address (CO-DIAN-001, CO-PILA-003 A1-013; Mandatory=Y).
Spec ref: Company.Country_Code (CO-DIAN-001, Mandatory=Y).
Spec ref: Company.Department_Code (CO-DIAN-001, CO-DIAN-004, CO-PILA-003; Mandatory=Y). Use the DANE DIVIPOLA catalogue, NOT the ISO 3166-2:CO list.

CF.Format: N(5) full DIVIPOLA on the nómina electrónica (11001); N(3) suffix on PILA and Formulario 220
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Company.Municipality_Code (CO-DIAN-001) and Company.City_Code (CO-DIAN-004 'Lugar donde se practicó la retención', CO-PILA-003). SPLIT-CODE TRAP - store five digits once and split into 2 + 3 on the artefacts that require it.

CF.PreCond: Mandatory for a Ley 1429 de 2010 beneficiary, i.e. where Class of Contributor = D or the Ley 1429 CCF benefit flag = S. Bidirectional set with those two fields and with the commercial-registry date.
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Company.Department_Code_Registry (CO-PILA-003 A1-031, Mandatory=C). Distinct from the ordinary employer department code, which follows the operating address.
Spec ref: Company.Phone (CO-PILA-003 A1-014, Mandatory=Y).
Spec ref: Company.Fax (CO-PILA-003 A1-015, Mandatory=N). Legacy field in the Resolución 2388 de 2016 layout - zero-fill where not held.

CF.Local: Dirección de correo electrónico del empleador
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Company.Email (CO-PILA-003 A1-016, Mandatory=Y).

CF.Local: Código de la sucursal o de la dependencia
CF.PreCond: MUST BE BLANK where Form of Presentation = U (único). Populated only where Form of Presentation = S (sucursal). Bidirectional pair with Form of Presentation and with the branch name.
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Company.Branch_Code (CO-PILA-003 A1-005 and T2R1-012, Mandatory=C). The Archivo Tipo 2 header value must equal the Archivo Tipo 1 value.

CF.Local: Nombre de la sucursal o de la dependencia
CF.PreCond: Populated together with the branch code, i.e. only where Form of Presentation = S. Where the branch has no name, the annex directs that the branch CODE is written here instead.
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Company.Branch_Name (CO-PILA-003 A1-006 and T2R1-013, Mandatory=C). Branches trading under the same corporate name are NOT separate registrations - CCG Module 2.1.

CF.Local: Código de actividad económica principal (CIIU rev. 4 A.C.)
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Company.CIIU_Code (CO-DIAN-002 self-withholding activity, CO-PILA-003 A1-030; Mandatory=Y/C). The SAME classification drives the occupational-risk class assignment and, for a legal person exonerated under ET art. 114-1, the self-withholding rate on Formulario 350. External catalogue - DIAN Resoluciones 000114 de 2020, 001232 de 2022 and successors; DANE Resolución 66 de 2012 for the PILA variant.
Spec ref: Company.DIAN_Seccional_Code (CO-DIAN-002 casilla 12, Mandatory=Y). A configuration constant per legal entity, not a per-return input. External DIAN catalogue.

CF.Local: Código de la ARL del aportante
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Company.ARL_Code (CO-PILA-003 T2R1-014, Mandatory=Y). EMPLOYER election (CCG Module 2.1 item 3), inherited by every employee.

CF.Local: Clase de riesgo laboral del centro de trabajo
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Company.Risk_Class (CO-PILA-003 T2R2-078, Mandatory=Y). Legal basis: Decreto 1072 de 2015 arts. 2.2.4.2.5.6 and 2.2.4.3.5. The class is master data held per work centre; the RATE (initial rate and the class minimum/maximum) is a parameter (WTC), NOT DD. Bidirectional set with Work Centre Code and the VCT change-of-work-centre event.

CF.PreCond: MANDATORY for an employer benefiting from the Ley 1429 de 2010 formalisation regime, i.e. where Class of Contributor = D or the Ley 1429 CCF benefit flag = S. Bidirectional set with those fields and with the registered-seat department code.
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Company.Commercial_Registry_Date (CO-PILA-003 A1-028, Mandatory=C).

CF.FieldName: Exonerated from Health, SENA and ICBF (art. 114-1)
CF.Local: Aportante exonerado de aportes a salud, SENA e ICBF
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Company.Exonerated_Flag (CO-PILA-003 A1-033, Mandatory=Y). THE EXONERATION NEVER TOUCHES pension (12%), occupational risk, or the family compensation fund (4%). It is also disapplied per employee where the health contribution base reaches 10 minimum wages - that per-contributor test produces a DERIVED value on the return (CALC), not a second master-data field. Bidirectional with the CIIU self-withholding activity code on Formulario 350.

CF.Local: Aportante acogido a los beneficios del artículo 5 de la Ley 1429 de 2010 (CCF)
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Company.Ley1429_CCF_Flag (CO-PILA-003 A1-034, Mandatory=Y). Where S, the commercial-registry date and the registered-seat department code become mandatory and Class of Contributor is normally D.

CF.Local: Código del fondo de cesantías de la planilla (fondo único)
CF.PreCond: Mandatory where the employer files a single-fund severance deposit planilla; blank where each employee's own fund code governs.
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Company.Cesantias_Fund_Code (declared in build_co_specs._DD_MASTER_MAPPINGS; the single-fund indicator is CO-CESANTIAS-006 E07, which back-references the per-employee field T02). Using a single fund where employees are affiliated to different funds MISDIRECTS the deposit - the penalty is one day's salary per day of delay, per employee, uncapped.

CF.Local: Tipo de acción (concordato, reestructuración, liquidación, cese)
CF.PreCond: Optional in general. Where populated it makes the insolvency start date MANDATORY and the commercial-activity cessation date required. Bidirectional set with both dates.
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Company.Action_Type (CO-PILA-003 A1-026, Mandatory=C). A value of 4 (cese de actividades) fixes the date from which the employer is no longer obliged to contribute.

CF.Local: Fecha de inicio del concordato, reestructuración, liquidación o cese de actividades
CF.PreCond: MANDATORY where the employer status action type is populated. Bidirectional pair with that field.
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Company.Insolvency_Start_Date (CO-PILA-003 A1-025, Mandatory=C).

CF.Local: Fecha en que terminó actividades comerciales
CF.PreCond: Required where the employer status action type is populated - the annex directs that it 'se debe diligenciar cuando se ha reportado información en el campo 26 de este registro'.
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Company.Trading_Cease_Date (CO-PILA-003 A1-027, Mandatory=C).

CF.PreCond: MANDATORY where Employer Person Type = J. Bidirectional pair with Employer Person Type.
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Company.Legal_Rep_First_Surname (CO-PILA-003 A1-019, Mandatory=C).
Spec ref: Company.Legal_Rep_Second_Surname (CO-PILA-003 A1-020, Mandatory=N).

CF.PreCond: MANDATORY where Employer Person Type = J. Bidirectional pair with Employer Person Type.
CF.Notes: Spec ref: Company.Legal_Rep_First_Name (CO-PILA-003 A1-021, Mandatory=C).
Spec ref: Company.Legal_Rep_Second_Name (CO-PILA-003 A1-022, Mandatory=N).
